purpose: Move from a functional two-column cabin to a stronger command deck: left navigation, central operational deck, right proof/status rail, bottom Aquarium.
owner_feedback_addressed: current UI is improving but still not target form
needs clearer system status and control hierarchy
needs richer material/ornament identity while preserving function
layout_laws: The app must keep a viewport-fit cockpit layout.
The right rail must expose proof/status/boundary information.
Patch Forge, Mechanicus and Aquarium actions must remain accessible.
UX proof markers must remain visible in Aquarium.
UI success must not claim backend execution success.
visual_laws: Use gothic metal, dark glass, cyan proof lines, violet warp glow and restrained crimson trash-polka accents.
Use ornament and beveled metal as structure, not random decoration.
Motion cues must have reduced-motion fallback.
Keep text readable and dense enough for operator work.
not_claimed: full backend Patch Forge security complete
